failClosedNotes: No AC/DC distinction is invented because the official 2026 price sheet publishes a single ad-hoc energy price.

sources.evidence: Official sheet says prices valid from 2026-01-01; ad-hoc 0.50 EUR/kWh, 1.00 EUR start fee, 0.05 EUR/min blocking fee from 60 min after end of charging between 08:00 and 18:00.
